maddeler.e:
يتهادر (form VI)
# يَتَهَادَرُ (yatahādaru) /ja.ta.haː.da.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَهَادَرَ (tahādara)
# يَتَهَادَرَ (yatahādara) /ja.ta.haː.da.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَهَادَرَ (tahādara)
# يَتَهَادَرْ (yatahādar) /ja.ta.haː.dar/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَهَادَرَ (tahādara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
